text.en:
Title. The NDCM shall be renamed as National Disaster
Resilience Month (NDRM) to be observed for the whole month of July of every year.

Disaster Resilience. The NDRM shall be collectively observed
by all Filipinos throughout the country through the conduct of activities relative to
building disaster resilience covering the four thematic areas of disasters, namely,
disaster prevention and mitigation, disaster preparedness, disaster response, and
disaster rehabilitation and recovery.

Lead Agencies. The NDRRMC shall take the lead in the
preparation, coordination, organization and implementation of the programs and
activities under this Order. The Regional DRRM Councils, Local DRRM Councils and
Barangay DRM Committees shall ensure the implementation of all programs and
activities. Moreover, the NDRRMC is hereby authorized to call upon any department,
agency, office and instrumentality, including the private sector and civil service
organizations, for the necessary assistance in the discharge of its functions.

Separability. If any section or part of this Order is held
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected
shall remain in full force and effect.

Repealing Clause. Executive Order No. 137 (s. 1999) and all
orders, rules and regulations, issuances or any part thereof inconsistent with the
provisions of this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended or modified
accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this28tlay of June, in the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Seventeen.
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILTPPINES
